title: An apparently controversial take ok the Joker sequel

commenti.body: I know that this is not the kind of film that most people would care to talk about here, but it seems like there’s no other place to talk about its merits and how honest what it was going for is.

Yeah it feels like a successful deconstruction of the joker character as well, like ofc he's not likely going to be some criminal genius or serial killer, but much more likely to be abused and taken advantage of by those around him, just a sad broken man that is ultimately not a "sigma" or someone to be idolized.


Kinda hoping this kills off the unironic society joker meme tbh, I would eternally be thankful to Phillips and would go to see hangover 16 if it happens
